effects.prompt: One compact combat robot footstep: clacking metal toes, brief electric servo and heavy rubberized steel heel. Crisp PS2 science fiction industrial sound. Single dry impact, no voice, no music.

Loud angry security robot alarm beep. A sharp electronic chirp immediately, followed by a descending distorted electric growl and three warning bleeps. Dry isolated science fiction alert sound. No speech. No music.
Security robot powering up: relay clacks, spring-loaded armor snapping, little angry servo whine ending in a pneumatic lock. Single dry mechanical activation. No voice, no music.
Single combat robot armor hit: punchy dented metal clang, brief electrical arc and loose components rattling. Dry isolated game effect, no music.
Small hostile robot destroyed: metallic explosive crunch, broken gears scattering, sparking electronics and descending motor shutdown. Dry isolated game effect, no music.
Single industrial robot plasma rivet gun shot: electric snap, sharp pneumatic crack, tiny shell mechanism cycling. Dry isolated sci-fi weapon effect, no music.
Seamless steady loop of a small sinister security drone hovering: oscillating electric rotor, gritty low motor flutter, high servo buzz. Constant texture, no starts or stops, no speech or music.
Short factory intruder alarm: two harsh alternating industrial warning horn pulses, a rattling PA speaker and electrical distortion. Serious sci-fi security breach. No speech or music.

Single gigantic industrial walking robot footfall: enormous steel heel crunch, deep chassis thud, piston air discharge and loose chains settling. Immediate impact with short tail, dry isolated effect, no music.

Seamless steady giant robot movement loop: strained hydraulic pumps, slow grinding worm gears, ticking high torque electric motors and heavy cable tension. Dry machinery, no impact, no voice, no music.
Single huge hydraulic pile driver striking steel concrete: crushing low metallic boom, buckled plate crack and piston exhaust. Immediate ferocious impact, short dry tail, no music.

Giant industrial robot attack windup: high torque motor spins up, thick ratcheting gears tension a massive hydraulic arm, rising angry electric whine. Immediate onset, no final impact, no voice or music.
Gigantic forklift robot lunging forward: violent turbine surge, hydraulic pressure dump, brutal accelerating steel tracks and chassis rattle. Dry aggressive single movement, no voice or music.
Single shoulder-mounted industrial missile launcher: heavy hatch clack, sharp compressed ignition pop and brief rocket whoosh. Immediate launch, no explosion, no music.

Industrial robot floor purge activation: giant pressure valve opens with a mechanical bang, dense roaring superheated steam jets and electrical crackle. Immediate onset, dry isolated effect, no music.
Giant robot armored eye shutter locks shut: several heavy steel iris leaves clatter inward, end in a forceful magnetic latch and short electric snap. One dry mechanical action, no music.
Single gigantic industrial nail cannon shot: brutal pneumatic piston bang, sharp metallic projectile crack and fast ammunition feed clank. Immediate dry weapon shot, no explosion or music.
Giant robot armored core opens: heavy iris shutters scrape apart, pressurized steam escapes, hot hydraulic system sighs down. Dry isolated mechanical action, no voice or music.
Monstrous industrial robot overdrive activation: angry distorted machine horn, rising electrical transformer roar, three huge relay clicks. No human voice, no music, dry isolated effect.

Gigantic industrial robot catastrophic shutdown: seized gears grinding, detonating power relays, falling heavy chassis crash, final pathetic descending electronic whine. Dry isolated effect, no voice or music.
Massive articulated steel robot arm swinging fast at ankle height: sweeping hydraulic hiss, cable whip, heavy rotating gearbox growl. No contact impact, no voice or music.

Heavy factory security barricade rising from a steel floor slot: hydraulic jack growl, interlocking armored plates ratcheting upward, final locking clunk. Dry isolated single mechanical motion, no music.

speech.text: Intruder alert. Unauthorized life form in dispatch. Security units, intercept.
Loading apron sealed. Export handler online. Intruder disposal authorized.
Overtime protocol engaged. All safety restrictions suspended.
